title: Keel policy
description: One file that `keel compile` turns into Claude Code hooks' policy lock, permission deny rules, CODEOWNERS, a CI workflow and a GitHub ruleset.

approver.description: The human who approves HEAVY work and live migration batches.

agentIdentity.description: The agent's own GitHub identity (a GitHub App is recommended). Must differ from the approver and must not be a repo admin.

surfaces.description: Danger surfaces mapped to repo path globs. A PR touching any of them is HEAVY and needs the approver's review.

governancePaths.description: Extra files the agent may not edit (added to Keel's defaults).

markers.description: Environment variables that hold live credentials.

dbUrlPatterns.description: Regexes that identify a live database URL.

supabaseProjectIds.description: Projects the agent may migrate freely. Any other project is treated as live.

guardFile.description: Test setup file that carries the keel-test-db-guard check.

ledger.description: Feature ledgers (<dir>/<feature>/00-status.md, Keel conventions §3). block: an agent cannot check a gate box (G1/G2/G3/Ship) and cannot write product code while a HEAVY ledger says 'Blocked on: human approval'. The human flips gates with `keel approve`.

backPressure.description: Ordered check names CI must pass (each needs a command in `checks`).

alwaysOnTokens.description: Ceiling for always-on context (CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and their @imports), in tokens estimated conservatively by keel-ci.mjs (labeled est.). Default 2000 (D20b).

mode.description: What token overage does: warn (default when alwaysOnTokens is not set) or fail (default when it is). Over-long lines always fail.

checksOn.description: When keel-checks runs. all: in keel.yml with keel-rigor, on every PR event, review and push to a protected branch. code-changes: in its own .github/workflows/keel-checks.yml, only when a PR is opened, synchronized or reopened; keel-rigor keeps every event (a body edit or review re-runs only keel-rigor). Saves Actions minutes.

quality.description: The quality floor (D17/D18): checks the keel-checks job runs after the backPressure ladder, plus keel-rigor's threat-model rule. Every mode is fail | warn | off; warn runs the step with continue-on-error. Tools that install are pinned to exact versions.

audit.description: Dependency audit for the detected package manager (npm, pnpm, Yarn classic or Berry), run as JSON by keel-ci.mjs audit with the reviewed exceptions in `allow`. Other stacks set `command`.

command.description: Replaces Keel's audit (allow included), e.g. "pipx run --spec pip-audit==2.9.0 pip-audit -r requirements.txt".

allow.description: Reviewed exceptions (D23): an advisory listed here doesn't fail the audit until its reviewBy date passes. Once that date passes it fails again; an entry no longer reported warns.

id.description: The GitHub advisory id the audit reports.

reason.description: Why it doesn't apply or can't be fixed yet.

reviewBy.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the exception holds through this day (UTC).

secrets.description: Credential scan of the diff's added lines (builtin: the secrets gate's shapes) or gitleaks, downloaded and checked against a sha256.

allowPaths.description: Globs the builtin scan skips (fixtures that must hold key-shaped strings). gitleaks reads the project's .gitleaks.toml instead.

gitleaks.description: Override the pinned gitleaks release; the sha256 of gitleaks_<version>_linux_x64.tar.gz is required.

sast.description: semgrep (pinned) with semgrep/semgrep-rules at a pinned commit, plus the project's .semgrep.yml / .semgrep/. Opt-in: it installs semgrep on every run. PRs report only new findings.

rules.description: semgrep-rules directories to run (default: from the detected stack, e.g. javascript, typescript, python, go).

architecture.description: dependency-cruiser (pinned) against the project's own config. No config: keel compile notes it and CI prints a notice.

paths.description: Directories to check (default: whichever of src, lib, app, packages exist, else .).

limits.description: Clean-code limits (D20e): a ratchet on the files a PR changes. A changed file may not get worse than its base version and a new file meets the caps; code the PR only moves keeps its old measure. Each limit is a cap number or {max, mode}; mode warn (default) annotates, fail fails keel-checks.

mode.description: Default mode for every limit below.

functionLines.description: Lines per function, JS/TS via ESLint max-lines-per-function (default 80).

complexity.description: Cyclomatic complexity per function, JS/TS via ESLint complexity (default 15).

boundaries.description: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md module map: a stable module may not import a volatile one.

exclude.description: Globs the limits skip (node_modules, dist, build, vendor, *.min.* and .keel/ are always skipped).

formatter.description: Command the format hook runs on each file the agent writes (argv, no shell), e.g. "node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown". null = detected at compile time; false = none.

threatModel.description: keel-rigor: a HEAVY PR's feature ledger must have a spec.md with a non-empty Threat model section. The ledger is found from a "Feature: <slug>" line in the PR body, a ledger path in the body, or the branch name.
